scope: Independent aggregation of hash-bound reading receipts and applied knowledge-intake receipts. Source identities are opaque hashes only.
claim_boundaries: 808 is a candidate-file population closed by explicit reading or exclusion dispositions for the selected contexts. It is not 808 full-file semantic reviews.
The earlier 151-file scope is a historical selected-contract review, not a new full-source read; the disjoint union has 959 files with some declared semantic scope.
543 nonmatching nonempty UTF-8 files received only metadata/shape classification and mechanical search. A missing pattern is not proof that a generic fact is absent.

The 21 initial candidate reads comprise 14 stated full-file reads and seven bounded reads, including one line-prefix cap. The remaining 787 use uncapped match discovery with bounded reading, schema projection or explicit deduplication.

Line numbers are one-based inclusive. Character spans are Unicode character offsets, zero-based and half-open. Projected JSON coordinates refer to the decoded string identified only by its key hash, not raw source-line byte offsets.

Literal-identical host contexts reuse a presented representative with matching context SHA-256. Normalized prefix groups suppress a numeric candidate suffix only; unrelated question bodies are excluded from the semantic-read claim.
Ranges ending beyond the actual line or file end are clamped to actual available text in the public coordinates; the count of such coordinate normalizations is recorded.
No source images were rendered and no encrypted artifacts were decrypted. UTF-8 decoding does not inspect embedded encoded media or encrypted payloads.

The updates are knowledge references and uncertainty boundaries, not implementations of all documented formats. External tools, matching symbols, acquired schemas and version-specific readers remain necessary.

A hash match, expression gate or regression pass does not establish semantic equivalence of all source text, absence of every omission, legal clearance, actor attribution or universal Tier 3 capability.
Fact groups and uncertainty rows can overlap across reviewers and artifacts. They must not be summed as unique facts or unique affected files.
